not-offered: not an ability Coach may run — use the tools declared for this conversation.
seat-required: needs a signed-in account; tell the person to sign in for this.
one-proposal: you already wrote a proposal for this roadmap in this answer; fold both into one.
coach-turn-volume: this answer has used its ability calls; answer the person with what you have.
stopped: Coach was stopped before this action.
invalid-input: the input does not match the ability's schema; check it and call again.
roadmap-unavailable: the device has not finished bringing this roadmap; tell the person to ask again once it has.
unknown-roadmap: no roadmap of the person's has this id; list_trees names theirs.
roadmap-not-ready: this step is under a delete the person can still undo; leave it alone.
not-owner: the person does not own this roadmap, so Coach can only read it.
out-of-scope: a change made at once names only this conversation's roadmap; suggest anything else.
over-limit: this would pass one of the roadmap's limits; make it shorter or smaller.
unknown-step: the roadmap holds no step with this id; read it again before you name one.
closes-cycle: this link would close a loop, and a step cannot wait on itself.
takes-every-start: this would remove the roadmap's last starting step; keep one.
unknown-kind: the roadmap has no kind with this id; use one its kinds name.
address-not-allowed: a step cannot carry this web address.
opens-roadmap: this step opens a roadmap and is done when that roadmap is; it takes no mark.
step-locked: this step is locked; complete what it needs first, or suggest that.
hue-taken: another kind wears this colour; pick another.
roadmap-changed: the roadmap changed since you read it; read it again from the first page.
no-change: the step already holds this; nothing was written.
